subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The manager along with his assistants (1)/ were assigned the task (2)/ by the board (3)/ last week. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb "were" in part 2.
 
• When the subject consists of a phrase like "The manager along with his assistants," the verb should agree with the main subject ("The manager").
 
• The correct phrase should be "was assigned the task," ensuring the verb agrees with the singular subject.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The manager, along with his assistants, was assigned the task by the board last week."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **(1): "The manager along with his assistants" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct but requires the verb to agree with the singular noun "manager."
 
• **(3): "by the board" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **(4): "last week." **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
